card.name: First digits inside ID numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or symbols right at the start of an identifier number, such as after NCT, in a URL handle or document ID, or in a COP conference number. Mostly the first digit or the separator before the digits.

modes.label: Trial registry numbers
modes.description: The first digit after NCT in a clinical trial identifier.

modes.label: URL and DOI numbers
modes.description: The slash, equals sign or period just before the numeric part of a link or DOI.

modes.label: COP and journal numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a conference or volume number, such as COP16.

card.plain: It fires on the opening digit of long ID codes, like trial numbers, web links and conference numbers.
